packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-21 - first reader, unverified image reading (UTF-8 plain text)

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001.jpg, reduced overview, face A)
- Black background, colour checker lower left, cm scale right edge (~38 cm visible). A grey card placeholder upper left.
- About 13 separate small parchment scraps, not a leaf. Left group: four or five tiny scraps (approx. 2-4 cm), no text visible at overview scale; one with holes (sewing/nail holes?).
- Centre: a fragment mounted on (or a stained) paper slip with pencil "Frg. 259 - 8u" (? read at overview scale) bottom; heavy dark stain blot over its centre; little or no script legible at overview.
- Right side: two columns of scraps. Right-most column: (a) narrow strip upper right (~2 x 3.5 cm) with ~7 lines of a small Gothic textualis in brown ink; (b) larger piece middle right (~4 x 5.5 cm) with ~14 lines; (c) lower right piece (~4 x 5 cm) with ~6-7 lines at top, pencil shelfmark-like note near bottom ("...259...").
- Middle-right column: three scraps (upper, middle, lower) that show mostly stained/blank surface at overview scale (possibly the other face of text pieces, or text worn away); pencil notes on some.
- No columns, rubrics, initials or glosses distinguishable at overview scale. Script: single column of small Gothic book hand on the text-bearing scraps (observation only).

image-002.jpg (native tile; upper-left of the centre/right group of face A)
- Shows the paper-mounted central fragment (pencil note at foot, read: "Frg. 259 - 8u" or "-8n"; the last characters uncertain) and the upper scrap of the middle-right column (pencil "Frg. 259-..." at foot), plus the top edge of the middle scrap of that column.
- Central fragment: decayed parchment remains (or offset/residue) on a paper backing; dark granular stain; a few tiny red/orange specks near the top (possibly rubric ink residue, or pigment; tentative). No letters legible.
- Upper middle-right scrap: stained, flesh/hair surface with no script visible at this resolution (blank face or ink entirely lost).
- No transcription possible from this tile.

image-003.jpg (native tile; upper-right of the centre/right group of face A)
Contents: upper scrap of middle-right column (left, stained, pencil "Frg. 258-6u"(?) - read "258" or "259"; no script visible, only faint marks near mid-left that may be offset or a pencil note); lower part of the narrow upper-right strip (top right, cut by the tile's top edge, ~6 lines visible, pencil "259..." at its foot); the larger middle-right text scrap (lower right, ~14 lines); top of the lower middle-right scrap (bottom left, stained, no script visible).

Middle-right text scrap ("scrap B"): the script is UPSIDE DOWN as photographed (pencil "259-8u"(?) written vertically along its left edge in the photo). I rotated it 180 degrees to read: crop-01.jpg (2x enlargement as photographed), crop-03.jpg (same rotated 180), crop-04.jpg (blue channel, autocontrast, rotated). Lines below are numbered in the ROTATED (reading) orientation, crop-03 line 1 = bottom line of the scrap as it lies in image-003. Small Gothic textualis, brown ink, single column, no ruling visible, left margin not preserved (text cut on both sides; right edge in reading orientation is the pencil-numbered edge, possibly near the original margin). Script worn; many letters uncertain.

crop-03 / image-003 scrap B (reading orientation)
L1  [tops of letters only; illegible]
L2  [..]erris(?) · eg(o)(?) b(e)n(e)d(i)c[..] (stroke over g; "bndcu"/"bndcā" with abbreviation stroke; end uncertain)
L3  [..]te(?)[..] ut dign(us)(?)' [..]  (last word has a superscript '9'-like -us sign: "dignı'" ; final word fragment "b.." or "li.." illegible)
L4  [..]a(?) ip(s)o(?) ⁊ p(er)(?) xp(istu)m(?)  (the last group looks like "p" with crossbar + "xp" + minim strokes; reading "p(er) xp(istu)m" is tentative)
L5  [..]n[..]c(?) sumat fru[..]  ("sumat" fairly clear; "fru" then cut/abraded)
L6  [..]quia(?) [..]ti(?) q(ua)n(?)tu(?) p[..]  (abbreviation strokes over several letters)
L7  [..] (in)p(ri)ma(?) [..]d[..]  [illegible]
L8  [..]ui(?)n eq(ui)s(?) [illegible]
L9  [..]n(?)e(?)[..] [illegible] a[..]
L10 [..] testam(en)t[..]  ("testa" + abbreviated "m(en)t", fairly clear; word before illegible)
L11 [..]n(?)ctu(?) a(?)re(?) [..]  (a later? pen stroke crosses this line horizontally at left-centre)
L12 [..]d(?) ?(?) fi(li)o(?) acc[..] / "ffo acte"(?)  [uncertain]
L13 [tops only; illegible]
Limitations: ink faint and abraded, letter shapes ambiguous; I could not secure continuous phrases beyond "sumat fru-", "testament-", "ut dign-", "eg(o)(?) b(e)n(e)d(ic)-".

image-004.jpg (native tile; lower-left of the centre/right group of face A)
- Bottom of paper-mounted central fragment, pencil "Frg. 259 - 8u"(?) (overlaps image-002).
- Lower-left scrap: blank/stained surface, pencil "Frg. 259-7u"(?); a folded-over strip along its left edge; no script.
- Middle scrap of middle-right column (right edge, cut): pencil "Frg. / 259 - 5u"(? the 259 boxed); no script visible.
- Lower scrap of middle-right column (bottom right, cut by tile edge): perforated, darker; faint letters visible (~5 lines), continued in image-005; transcribed there.

image-005.jpg (native tile; lower-right of the centre/right group of face A)
Contents: middle scrap of middle-right column (upper left; pencil "Frg. / 259 - 5u"(?); stained, no script); lower part of scrap B (upper right, upside down; overlaps image-003, not re-counted); lower-right text scrap "scrap C" (pencil "Frg. 259-1u"(?) at foot); lower scrap of middle-right column "scrap D" (bottom left, perforated, pencil "259-4u"(?)).

Scrap C (right way up; ~6 lines of the same-looking small Gothic textualis at the top of the piece, lower ~60% blank (lower margin? or a stained blank area). Text cut at left and right. Enlarged in crop-05.jpg. Lines numbered from the top of the scrap.
C1  [..]a(?) ⁊(?) [..]mandu(m)(?) [..]   ("-mandū" with stroke; preceding letters possibly "Ar-"/"cō-"; uncertain)
C2  [..]il(?) cess(?)it(?) · Do(m)i(n)[..]   (capital-like D after a punctus; "Dom..." with abbreviation; "cessit" uncertain)
C3  [..]ut(?) · T(?)uiq(?) meam(?) / meum(?) [..]
C4  [..]ilr(?) · p(?)osit(?) h(?)' huius(?) [..]   ("hui'" with -us sign, tentative)
C5  [..]⁊(?) alio(?) t(em)p(or)e(?) [..]   (could also be "olio"; "tēpore" read from a looped p with stroke)
C6  [..]e(?) cons(?) misit(?) / mihi(?) u(?)ir[..]   [largely uncertain]
C7  [ruled blank below?; no further text visible]

Scrap D (image-005 bottom left; crop-06.jpg). Dark, abraded, worm/insect holes; pencil "259-4u"(?). Traces of ~5 lines of larger, darker letters on the left half; no word secure.
D1  [illegible]
D2  [..]a[..]  [illegible]
D3  [..]n(?) [..]  [illegible]
D4  [..]ue(?)t(?) / "uet" [..]
D5  [..]e(?)b(?)ad(?) / "ebad"(?) [..]   (could be "-ent" or "-end"; uncertain)
D6  [traces]

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-006.jpg, reduced overview, face B = the other side of the same scraps)
- Same arrangement, scraps turned over (mirrored positions). Pencil numbers on this face end in "v" (e.g. paper slip "Frg. 259-8v" at top), so the pencil endings I read as "u" on face A are probably "r" (recto) - i.e. "259-8r", "259-1r", "259-4r" etc. (correction of my earlier pencil readings; not a text reading).
- Left group: tiny scraps; one has a bright pink/magenta coloured surface with a small folded gilt/brass-coloured strip (possibly a binding remnant: coloured paper/leather and metal). No script seen at overview scale.
- Centre paper slip: back of the paper with grey offset of the parchment remains; no script.
- Right side: the right-most column scraps show script on this face as well (upper narrow strip: traces; middle piece: several lines at top incl. what may be larger/red letters; lower piece: faint). Middle-right column scraps: mostly stained, little visible script; lower perforated scrap shows a few letters at left.

image-007.jpg (native tile; upper-left of the centre/right group of face B)
- Paper slip "Frg 259-8v" (pencil, clear): back of the paper, grey show-through/offset of the parchment remains; no script.
- Edges of the upper and middle scraps of the middle-right column (pencil "Frg. 2.." on each); no script visible.
- No transcription possible from this tile.

image-008.jpg (native tile; upper-right of the centre/right group of face B)
- Upper scrap of middle-right column, pencil "Frg. 259-6v": stained, no script.
- Narrow upper-right strip, pencil "259-3v": stained, partly flaked; a small rectangular darker patch (paper/parchment repair or adhering fragment?) near the foot; no legible script on this face.
- Top of scrap B, face B (bottom right; pencil "2[5]9..." vertical, lower centre). Lines appear upright in the photo. Heavily abraded and flaked, only the top ~4 lines have letters. Enlarged in crop-07.jpg. Lines numbered from top of scrap.
Bv1  [..]e(?)[..] [..]c(?)u(m)(?) d[..]   [mostly illegible]
Bv2  [..] q(?)ua(?) / "q̄a"(?) radi(?)c[..] / "rada"(?)   (the "ra" fairly clear)
Bv3  [..] ex(?)[.]ano(?) fra[..]   ("e" + long letter + "ano" then "fra" with possible abbreviation; uncertain; could be "ex fano" or "expiano")
Bv4  [..]n(?)a[..] ⁊(?) [..] [..]e(?)
Bv5-  [traces only in the remaining lines visible here; continue on image-010]

image-010.jpg (native tile; lower-right of the centre/right group of face B)
- Middle scrap of middle-right column, pencil "Frg. 259-5v": stained, a hole; faint marks near centre ("..a"?) but no legible script.
- Lower part of scrap B face B (upper right), pencil "259-2v" vertical (so scrap B = "259-2"). Overlaps image-008 at the top ("ex[.]ano fra" line visible again; not re-counted). Below that, ~8 more lines exist but the surface is flaked/abraded; only traces. Near the foot at right: "[..]fra(?)" and last line "[..]ffiam(?) / [..]ssimi(?)" - uncertain.
- Scrap C face B (lower right), pencil "Frg. 259-1v": a folded/overlapping strip along the left side; faint text of ~8-9 lines in the upper right portion, very abraded. crop-08.jpg (contrast-enhanced). Only letter traces: line 1 right "[..]q(?)b(?)[..]"; line 2 "[..]e(?)r[..]"; line 3 "[..]n(?)a(?)[..]"; others [illegible]. No word secure.
- Scrap D face B (bottom left), pencil "259-4v": dark brown surface, holes; no script visible.

image-009.jpg (native tile; lower-left of the centre/right group of face B)
- Foot of paper slip (offset only). Scrap "Frg. 259-7v": folded edge strip at right, a small red/pink stain near the foot (pigment or modern?); no script. Edges of 259-5v and 259-4v. No transcription possible.

image-011.jpg (native tile; left group of small scraps, face A)
- Grey card; a strip-shaped scrap (top right) with a crease; a polygonal brown scrap with two holes (sewing/tacket holes?); a tiny scrap; a square scrap with a metal (brass?) nail/rivet head or stud in it (bottom). These look like binding remnants (parchment/leather). No script visible on any of them.

image-012.jpg (native tile; left group of small scraps, face B)
- Strip scrap (top right): stained, no script. Polygonal dark scrap with two holes: no script. Tiny scrap: none.
- Bottom: the square scrap's other side is covered with pink/magenta-coloured material (paper or leather), with a brass strip (bent, riveted through) lying over it; the brass shows engraved/punched ornament (foliate or zigzag marks), not readable as letters. Binding furniture (clasp/catch plate?) - tentative.

Narrow upper-right strip, face A ("scrap E", pencil "259-3r"(?) at its foot) - lower part only, from the top edge of image-003 (re-cropped: crop-09.jpg, 3x). The strip's top lines lie above the tile edge and are visible only on the reduced overview image-001 (not transcribed from it). Orientation of the script as photographed is uncertain to me (letters look upright but heavily abraded). Lines counted from the top of crop-09.
E1  [tops of letters; illegible]
E2  [..]D(?)[.] mu(s)(?) / "mū"(?) [..]   (large round letter at left, possibly an initial or "d")
E3  [..]m(?) sep(?) / "fep"(?) [..]
E4  [..]S(?)p(?)eat(?) / "sitat"(?) [..]
E5  [..]ro(?)ma(?)m(?) / "rōam"(?) [..]
E6  [pencil "259-3.." overlies traces; illegible]
No word secure on this strip.

SUMMARY / LIMITATIONS
- The record is a set of ~13 small parchment scraps plus binding remnants (brass strip, pink-covered scrap, nail/stud), pencil-numbered "Frg. 259-1" to "259-8" with r/v. Text survives on four scraps: 259-2 (scrap B, both faces; face A ~13 lines, upside down as photographed; face B ~4 legible lines), 259-1 (scrap C; face A 6 lines, face B traces), 259-4 (scrap D; traces), 259-3 (scrap E; face A ~5 lines of traces). Others (259-5, -6, -7, -8 and the unnumbered small scraps) show no script I could see.
- Script: small Gothic textualis, brown ink, single column (no column boundary or ruling seen), Latin with standard abbreviations (stroke for m/n, ⁊, -us sign, p with bar). No rubrics read; tiny red specks on 259-8 and a red stain on 259-7v are not demonstrably rubrication.
- Best readings (all tentative): "sumat fru-", "testam(en)t-", "ut dign-", "eg(o)(?) b(e)n(e)d(ic)-", "ip(s)o ⁊ p(er) xp(istu)m(?)" (259-2r); "-mandu(m)", "· Dom-", "alio(?) t(em)p(or)e(?)", "huius(?)" (259-1r); "ex[.]ano fra-", "radi-/rada" (259-2v).
- Unread: top lines of scrap E (only on the reduced overview); most of 259-2v and 259-1v (flaked/abraded). A higher-resolution or UV/multispectral view of 259-2v and 259-1v, and a native tile of the top of 259-3r, would be needed.
- Exposure: nothing in my context revealed an identification or proposed reading. Beyond the brief: none; I made crops (crop-01, -03 to -09) only in my scratch folder; crop-02 was made (mirror) and deleted unviewed.
